pages.name: Checkout Flow
pages.description: Complete checkout flow with tokenized payment input, multi-currency selector, and order confirmation. Designed by Elena Torres (etorres). References PAY-101 tokenization and PAY-103 multi-currency support.

pages.name: Transaction History
pages.description: Transaction history view with filtering by date range, currency, status, and merchant. Shows tokenized card details (last 4 digits only). References PAY-101 tokenization display.

pages.name: Settlement Dashboard
pages.description: Settlement dashboard showing batch status, reconciliation results, and settlement file download. References PAY-301 batch processor and PAY-302 reconciliation. Designed by Elena Torres (etorres).

pages.name: Webhook Configuration UI
pages.description: Merchant webhook registration and management interface with URL configuration, event type selection, and delivery log viewer

pages.name: Analytics Dashboard Design
pages.description: Real-time payment analytics dashboard with transaction volume charts, success rate gauges, settlement timeline, and merchant performance comparison

components.name: PaymentCard
components.description: Payment card input component with PCI DSS compliant iframe for PAN entry. Displays tokenized card info (last 4 digits, brand icon). Used in Checkout Flow page.

components.name: CurrencySelector
components.description: Multi-currency dropdown selector with real-time FX rate display. Supports USD, EUR, GBP, JPY, CAD, AUD, CHF. Shows conversion preview before payment. References PAY-103.

components.name: SettlementTable
components.description: Settlement batch summary table showing batch ID, status, transaction count, total amount, and reconciliation status. Used in Settlement Dashboard page. References PAY-301, PAY-302.

components.name: RetryBanner
components.description: Banner component displayed when a payment is being retried. Shows retry count, circuit breaker status, and estimated completion time. References PAY-102 retry handler.

components.name: WebhookConfigPanel
components.description: Webhook URL configuration panel with endpoint registration, event type toggles, and test delivery button

components.name: AnalyticsChart
components.description: Reusable analytics chart component supporting line, bar, gauge, and heatmap visualizations

components.name: MerchantPerformanceCard
components.description: Merchant performance summary card showing transaction volume, success rate, and webhook delivery stats
